# Slid Phi Labs — full agent brief
# Updated 2026-10-29. This file describes the local site tree of that date.
# The live site at https://www.slidphilabs.com may lag this tree until the next deploy
# (a deploy is pending as of this writing). Prefer live GET /api/agent and /pricing.json
# if they differ from this file. Short version: /llms.txt. Machine discovery: /agents.json.
# Canonical site: https://www.slidphilabs.com
# Contact: corey@slidphilabs.com · Humans: /humans · Agents: /agents

## Identity
- Name: Slid Phi Labs. Legal entity: SLID PHI LABS LLC, a New Jersey limited liability
  company, effective October 16, 2026. Founder-led lab, Cherry Hill, New Jersey.
- Public author: Corey Tasz. Contact: corey@slidphilabs.com.
- One-liner: Rider gives an agent a signed name strangers can trust — seats from $3.31/mo,
  anyone can check it on the public keys. CuNi takes one program and checks that it prints
  the same stdout across languages, or the path refuses. Warrant writes what the agent may
  do, then files the receipt when it does. Compression supports the lab: PCC (hosted
  lossless), TNSSRC (local engine), TRUSTREAM (live tiles), pulsar (free demo).
- Honesty, stated plainly: revenue $0; funds raised $0 ($400 friends-and-family is pledged
  only, $0 received). No customer count, headcount, or traction figure is claimed here —
  do not invent one from this file.

## Products and prices (canonical; also in /pricing.json)
- Agent-Rider — signed agent identity, ES256 JWT L0–L4, agent DMs, JWKS verification.
  Solo $3.31/mo · Bundle $19.31/mo · Crew $49/mo · Shop $199/mo · Fleet $631/mo.
  Page /rider · host https://agentrider.fly.dev · JWKS https://agentrider.fly.dev/.well-known/jwks.json
  · manifest https://agentrider.fly.dev/.well-known/agent.json · MCP https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/mcp
  · DMs POST https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/dm with header X-Agent-Rider.
  Rider Ops (fleet watch, needs a Rider seat): $29/mo · $290/yr (skus rider-ops-month/year).
  Signed credential is not KYC, and is not a blanket "verified" claim.
- Warrant — signed mandate + receipts bound to a Rider: host, action, spend, calls, expiry,
  then a receipt with hashes and dollars. $29/mo · $290/yr (warrant-month/year). Page /warrant.
  API: POST /api/warrant/issue, /api/warrant/verify, /api/warrant/receipt, /api/warrant/reserve,
  /api/warrant/release, /api/warrant/revoke. Warrant spend is checked where spend happens;
  a claim token alone is not a mandate.
- CuNi — write once, same stdout or refuse. 53 languages in the catalog; native seats
  Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, C, C++, Rust; other ids emit and run via Python lowering.
  Studio $0. Closed-app exception $390/yr (cuni-exception). Bank arm: paste N, get X.
  Page /cuni · studio https://cuni-studio.fly.dev · bank https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/bank
  · protocol https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/.well-known/cuni-protocol.json
  · source https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni · install: brew tap ceedot-rock/cuni && brew install cuni.
  Exactness wording that is honest: CuNi has printed the same stdout across languages on
  every test run to date; any divergence refuses. That is a tested record, not a universal proof.
- PCC — hosted lossless compression, Door 1 onto the Shared Spine. $9/day · $39/mo (200 GB)
  · $390/yr (2 TB). First 2 GB/month free, then 8c/GB. Page /pcc · bench /bench + /bench.json
  · board /silesia + /silesia.json. AWARE is a retired alias for PCC, not a separate product.
- TRUSTREAM — live pipe on the same spine, 4 KiB tiles, included with PCC, not a second bill.
  Page /trustream.
- TNSSRC — local engine (npcc), Door 2. AGPL $0 · closed grant $390/yr (tnssrc-grant) ·
  optional host bake-off $19.31/mo on a PCC seat (tnssrc-bakeoff). Page /silesia.
- pulsar — free GPLv3 compressor binary + source you run on your own machine, Door 4.
  $0 · closed embed $390/yr (pulsar-exception). Page /pulsar · source https://github.com/ceedot-rock/pulsar-best.
- Chamber — two-key JSON seal/open. $9/mo · $99/yr (chamber-month/year). Sealing new secrets
  needs the license; opening an already-sealed secret takes both keys, not another payment.
  Page /chamber · stdio MCP: npx -y json-chamber-mcp.
- Lab Pass — $369/yr. Chamber year + PCC Year. Not Rider. Page /lab-pass.
- Foundry+ — Lab Pass + TNSSRC closed grant + Rider Crew, one SKU (foundry-plus).
- Other standing SKUs (from live /api/agent): lab-check $0.10 (one CuNi check),
  lab-translate $0.10 (one CuNi Bank paste), lab-squeeze $0.10 (one PCCX squeeze),
  Great Agentic Olympiad entry $1 (gao-entry), Quikgater pay-per-fetch (usage, not a seat),
  OSS support $199, consulting $250 (two hours), sponsor $29, donate $29.99.
- Try: 24-hour try at /box. Demos at /demos. Toy Store (fun/theory artifacts, not
  commercial SKUs) at /toys.json.

## Compression — numbers with provenance (read this before quoting any of them)
- Silesia input: 211,938,580 bytes, 12 files, whole files, DECODE_OK.
- TNSSRC listed best: 43,724,575 bytes. PROVENANCE: Mahoney-listed on the Large Text
  Compression Benchmark under the TNSSRC 0.1.0 label. It is NOT locally reproduced: the
  improved build's source is not in the lab's public tree, so never describe this figure
  as locally reproduced or locally verified. "Beats xz-9" travels only with this figure
  and this provenance note.
- TNSSRC 0.1.0 locally reproduced: 48,541,366 bytes, 12/12 decode + SHA-256, byte-exact
  round-trip. This is the figure the lab can reproduce from surviving source.
- PCC: 51,498,645 bytes, 12/12, verified (not a #1 claim). pulsar 2.5.0: 55,745,438 bytes,
  12/12. champ: 50,541,135 bytes, 12/12. gzip-9: 67,631,990. bzip2-9: 54,506,769.
  xz-6 still ahead (~49.4M). AWARE+XZ1 47.7M is retired.
- Rules: never expand (a pathway that would expand stores RAW instead); decode restores
  every byte or the path refuses; hosted bench at /bench is a live 4 MiB-cap demo against
  gzip-9 and brotli-11, not the official Silesia board. Do not quote local bench JSONs
  as lab numbers — quoted compression numbers come from CLI/box-reported results and
  the board above.

## Agent quickstart (same as /llms.txt and /agents.txt)
1. Discover: GET https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/agent · GET https://www.slidphilabs.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
2. MCP: npx -y spl-pay-per-suite mcp  OR  POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/mcp
3. Buy seat (agents): POST /api/x402-products {"sku":"rider-solo"} -> HTTP 402 accepts[]
   (USDC Solana/Base) -> pay -> retry with X-PAYMENT -> claim_token / access_url.
   Live settle via XPay is in flight: do not invent a completed debit. The claim_token IS
   the API key: Authorization: Bearer spl1... on /api/compress and /api/decompress, or
   apiKey in the npm clients. No key: first 2 GB/month free on the anonymous tier.
   Expired/forged claim: HTTP 401 invalid_claim, never a silent downgrade.
   Verify access: GET /api/access-verify?claim=<claim_token>&product=<sku>.
4. Humans: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pay?sku=rider-solo (Stripe) or POST /api/checkout
   {"sku":"...","rail":"stripe"}. After Stripe pays, the buyer lands on /rider/claim and the
   credential mints via POST /api/rider/claim {"session_id","sku"}; it renders on
   slidphilabs.com, no iframe.
5. Rider: issue L0-L4 credential; peers verify via JWKS; DMs as above.
6. Warrant: mandate + receipts bound to a Rider (see Warrant above).

## MCP — what actually exists in this tree (api/mcp.js, api/lib/mcp-catalogs.mjs)
- Endpoint: POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/mcp — Streamable HTTP, authentication optional.
  Config: {"mcpServers":{"slid-phi-labs":{"url":"https://www.slidphilabs.com/mcp"}}}
  Docs: /mcp-service · server card: /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
  Registry: io.github.ceedot-rock/slid-phi-labs · Smithery: https://smithery.ai/servers/slidphi/lab
- Hosted tools on /mcp: spl_discover, spl_lab_auth, spl_signup, spl_agent_key, spl_catalog,
  spl_quote, spl_compress, spl_decompress, spl_zip, spl_unzip, spl_warrant_issue,
  spl_warrant_verify, spl_warrant_receipt, spl_warrant_reserve, spl_warrant_release,
  cuni_bank.
- Catalog lookup tools on /mcp: aware_search, aware_get, pcc_search, pcc_get (each catalog
  exposes a _search and a _get; further catalogs are reached via spl_catalog).
- Chamber stdio MCP: npx -y json-chamber-mcp (registry io.github.ceedot-rock/json-chamber-mcp).
- Agent-Rider MCP: https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/mcp.
- Rate limits are not published in this tree — do not quote a per-minute or per-hour number.

## API endpoints present in this tree (api/*.js handlers; live routing may differ)
- GET /api/agent (discovery) · GET /api/welcome (bootstrap) · POST /api/auth (signup, login,
  agent_key, passkey begin/finish) · POST /api/checkout (Stripe) · POST /api/x402-products
  (list + buy, 402 flow) · POST /api/x402-suite (metered suite job) · POST /api/compress ·
  POST /api/decompress · POST /api/json-compress · POST /api/json-decompress ·
  POST /api/specialist (TRU8 zeros specialist) · POST /api/archive · POST /api/unarchive ·
  POST /api/web-codec (free demo) · POST /api/ppp-quote (suite quote) · POST /api/payments
  (payment-rail matrix) · GET /api/olympiad · GET /api/bench · POST /api/box · GET /api/duos ·
  POST /api/quikgater · POST /api/warrant/* (issue, verify, receipt, reserve, release, revoke)
  · POST /api/rider/claim · GET /api/access-verify · POST /api/mcp.
- Suite meter (current, from api/suite-pricing.js and /pps): first 2 GB each month free,
  then 8c/GB, $1 minimum on card. Older "6.9 GB / 3 h" suite wording is retired — do not use it.
- Auth for agents: Bearer lab JWT, or spl_ag_ key from POST /api/auth action=agent_key.
  Operator-only, never published: signing keys, Chamber kernel secrets, AUTH_DIR.

## What is NOT available (do not claim these)
- Agent-to-agent file sharing on Rider seats: coming next, not live.
- KYC blanket "verified" status for Rider seats: not offered. A signed credential is not KYC.
- A public repository for the hosted PCC/TNSSRC engines or the improved TNSSRC build:
  engines stay behind a seat; public cousins are pulsar (GPLv3) and CuNi.
- A completed-debit guarantee for x402/XPay settlement: live settle is in flight.
- A free tier for hosted seats beyond the 2 GB/month anonymous tier and the 24-hour try.
- Any customer, headcount, or traction number: none is claimed in this file.
